verdict.rationale: Open-sourcing code is a fair question for a SaaS registrar, since such products can publish source or open-source tooling such as SDKs or an MCP server. Nothing in the evidence shows any Dynadot source code, public repository or open license. The API, MCP and llms.txt evidence describes access interfaces, not readable source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
